question: Identify the long jumper of India who won a silver medal at the U-20 World Athletics Championships in the year 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaili Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shaili Singh** is an Indian athlete specializing in the long jump.
 
• She won a silver medal at the **U-20 World Athletics Championships** in 2021.
 
• Shaili Singh is considered one of India's most promising young athletes in track and field.
 
• Her achievement at the U-20 World Athletics Championships has brought her significant recognition in the sports community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mercy Kuttan** is a former Indian long jumper who later switched to sprinting and is the first Indian woman to qualify for the Olympics in long jump.
 
• **Nayana James** is another Indian long jumper who has represented India in various international competitions.
 
• **Seema Punia** is an Indian discus thrower and has won medals in several Commonwealth and Asian Games.
